steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Internal energy U = Σ(KE + PE) of molecules; Temperature ∝ mean KE per molecule

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Q = mcDeltaθ (no phase change); Q = mL (phase change); L_fusion, L_vaporisation

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 1st law: DeltaU = Q + W; W = ∫PdV (work done ON gas); Q +ve into system, W +ve on system

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ideal gas: pV = nRT = NkT; Boyle p∝1/V (isothermal), Charles V∝T (isobaric), Pressure p∝T (isochoric)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: 2 moles of ideal gas at 300 K compressed isothermally from 0.02 m^3 to 0.01 m^3. Find work done --- Solution: Isothermal: W = ∫PdV = ∫(nRT/V)dV = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2x8.31x300xln(0.5) = -3457 J. Work done ON gas = +3457 J

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Heat to raise 500 g water from 20 deg C to 80 deg C (c=4180) | 1 mole gas at 27 deg C, V=0.022 m^3. Find pressure | Explain why C_p > C_v for ideal gas

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of thermal physics with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: 2 moles of ideal gas at 300 K compressed isothermally from 0.02 m^3 to 0.01 m^3. Find work done. Solution: Isothermal: W = ∫PdV = ∫(nRT/V)dV = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2x8.31x300xln(0.5) = -3457 J. Work done ON gas = +3457 J Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min): Review answers and address misconceptions.
